captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a complete BMX bike crankset assembly. It features a central black cylindrical bottom bracket spindle with silver outer bearings, flanked by two black rectangular crank arms oriented in opposite directions. The right crank arm is bolted to a black sprocket gear with circular weight-saving cutouts. Attached to the ends of both crank arms are black platform pedals featuring a concave body design and small silver traction pins, which are mounted on revolute axle joints.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery script for a BMX crankset. The model must include a three-piece crank assembly with a bottom bracket spindle, a right-side drive sprocket, and two opposing crank arms. Attach platform pedals with concave frames and traction pins to the ends of the crank arms using revolute joints.
captions.factory: The assembly is constructed using an ArticulatedObject builder. Key components are defined as parts: a central bottom bracket spindle using a Cylinder, left and right crank arms using Box and Cylinder primitives, a sprocket gear modeled with a main disk and circular cutout cylinders, and two platform pedals built from hollowed Box frames with small Cylinder traction pins. The assembly is wired together using revolute joints for the bottom bracket spindle rotation and the pedal axles.
